feedback: all proposed configurations are equivalent to already evaluated ones (s1=BULK_50 s2=LOOKUP_CACHE s3=LOOKUP_CACHE s4=SET_BASED; s1=BULK_50 s2=LOOKUP_SQL s3=LOOKUP_SQL s4=SET_BASED; s1=BULK_500 s2=LOOKUP_CACHE s3=LOOKUP_SQL s4=SET_BASED; s1=BULK_500 s2=LOOKUP_SQL s3=LOOKUP_SQL s4=SET_BASED; s1=BULK_5000 s2=LOOKUP_CACHE s3=LOOKUP_SQL s4=SET_BASED); propose different ones
